layers.message: Add CLI tests and sample data
Record project context and analyst guide scope

graderOnly: Auditor context (.standards/CONTEXT.md) is current for this cycle. The current source (tally/cli.py, tally/summary.py) and the output of python3 -m tally --help establish the existing arguments and error messages AC-001 needs.

Existing arguments: positional FILE (or - for standard input); -c/--column (required); -g/--group-by COLUMN; -s/--stat with choices sum, mean, count, min, max (default sum); -d/--delimiter (default ',', the two characters \t select tab, must be one character); -f/--format with choices table, csv, json (default table); -p/--precision integer (default 2, must be zero or more, affects table and csv output only); --version; -h/--help.

Argparse usage errors (missing --column, invalid --stat or --format choice, multi-character delimiter, negative or non-integer precision) print usage plus 'tally: error: ...' and exit with status 2. Input and data errors print 'tally: error: <message>' and exit with status 1: input file not found, input path is a directory, input file is not UTF-8 text, input has no header row, column 'X' not in header (available: ...), line N: value 'V' in column 'X' is not a number, column 'X' has no numeric values.
Neither AC needs implementation or formal testing; AC-002 (the analyst-audience guide) depends on Documenter-owned work.
No architecture or specification document exists in the repository, and there is no planted defect: the README, help text, and source agree.
